One shared RAF clock; wheel multiplier 1 and lerp .16
Native touch, keyboard and nested scrolling; no pins

effects.purpose: Connect the studio identity to responsive gameplay systems
effects.desktop: 20 wave paths, sparse vertical connections and 9 travelling signals; bounded fine-pointer response; 30fps draw cap and 1.5 DPR cap
effects.mobile: 14 paths, 5 signals, no pointer tracking, 24fps draw cap and 1 DPR cap
effects.reduced_motion: Frozen composed frame, no render loop
effects.fallback: Static radial atmosphere; all content independent of canvas
effects.cleanup: Cancel RAF when paused, hidden, reduced motion or pagehide; restart only when permitted; preference stored locally

effects.purpose: Explore simulator, combat, input/audio and movement demos

effects.desktop: User-triggered 320ms image dissolve; hero panel moves up to 32px with natural scroll
effects.mobile: Same explicit demo selectors; no scroll translation
effects.reduced_motion: Immediate selection; no dissolve or translation
effects.fallback: Default simulator image, video link and text remain available
effects.cleanup: Cancel previous image animation on selection; global pause/reduced-motion cancels active animations
effects.data_truth: Existing recorded demo destinations; no automatic playback

effects.section: all major sections including About, stats, FAQ, form and footer
effects.purpose: Give the content a clear entrance rhythm without delaying navigation
effects.owner: motion.js IntersectionObserver and Web Animations API
effects.desktop: One-shot 22px entrance, 620ms, stagger capped at 110ms; process borders highlight in view
effects.mobile: Same short entrances in ordinary vertical flow
effects.fallback: Default styles are visible; no opacity-zero class
effects.cleanup: Unobserve after first appearance; cancel animations on pause/preference/visibility change

effects.purpose: Smooth wheel steps while preserving their distance
effects.desktop: Fine pointer, lerp .16, wheel multiplier 1; custom anchor history/focus/header offsets
effects.mobile: Native touch and scrolling; no smoother
effects.reduced_motion: Destroy instance, native scrolling remains usable
effects.fallback: Vendor failure leaves native document scroll and anchors
effects.cost: 18,722 bytes JS and 513 bytes CSS; no runtime dependencies
effects.cleanup: Destroy on pause, reduced motion, hidden/pagehide; recreate once on resume; reset around browser navigation

effects.section: About, experience, navigation and interactive cards
effects.purpose: Make each major section responsive to scroll and interaction
effects.owner: motion.js translate/CSS custom properties; independent from hover transforms
effects.desktop: Bounded image depth, section accent progress, current navigation and pointer lighting; short FAQ/filter transitions
effects.mobile: Static media geometry, tap/focus controls and progressive entrances
effects.reduced_motion: No spatial motion or pointer lighting; navigation remains functional
effects.cleanup: Reset media translation and cancel active animations when paused; pointer exit clears lighting
effects.data_truth: No changing business claims or fabricated counters
